title: Three deals. One answer.
blurb: Compare deals: pick 2–4 from your Pipeline and see every strategy's cash flow, cap rate, DSCR and cash to close side by side — best in each row marked, plus Caddie's pick.

scenes.line: Three good-looking deals. You can only buy one.
Compare puts them side by side: cash to close, cap rate, DSCR, and cash flow on every strategy.
The best number in every row is marked, so the winner jumps out.
Still torn? Ask Caddie which one to chase, and why.

wrap: Stop flipping between tabs. Pick the winner.
cover_sub: Side by side, best in every row, plus Caddie's pick
